dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric inward geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the visible posterior extremity.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Subtle outward protrusion on the mid-left lateral margin; right margin appears relatively linear before tapering.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Slate dark-grey to medium grey median intensity.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse light-grey patches located primarily along the dorsal midline and posterior region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient boundaries between the dark-grey baseline and lighter mottled areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A sharp, longitudinal light-colored line running down the center of the dorsal ridge and several small, bright-white circular punctate marks on the posterior dorsal surface.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: A pronounced longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis causing a visible linear contrast disruption.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent longitudinal linear mark/scar consistent with the central dorsal ridge orientation.
